title: Flow Core Dsl Engine Adoption
description: Build dsl:: engine support from scratch for flow/core/rs (package flow_core) — the crate holding FlowHost, FlowFixture, FlowDocument. Step 1: delete FlowHost's redundant snapshot-based undo/redo (FlowHistory struct + undo()/redo() around lines 1719/3220/3233), route undo/redo through the standard vcs::DocumentVcsStore/DocumentVcsEnvelope mechanism (FlowOperation/FlowDiff already implement vcs::Operation/OperationDiff correctly at lines ~4109-4230), rewrite undo_redo_add_widget test (~line 5290) to exercise vcs-based undo/redo. Step 2: add dsl:: derive layer — #[derive(dsl::DslDocument)] on FlowFixture (schema/camera/widgets/synapses/layout), dsl::DslOps on FlowOperation, local twins for foreign not-yet-converted types (neural_engine Dictionary/NeuralValue/Atom if embedded in Widget params), use already-converted infinite_board_port_directed_dag and mathematical_graph_manifest PropertyValue/PropertyBag directly if present. Convert flow/example/default.flow.json fixture from JSON to real .flow DSL text via migration-test round-trip procedure; check whether flow/manifest/dag.manifest.json is part of the document round trip or a separate build artifact. Verify with cargo test -p flow_core and cargo test -p flow-plugin (confirm exact name), CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/claude-flow-dslgreen-target. Per "wave G / greenfield" of the technologies dsl migration plan.
summary:
Step 1: Deleted FlowHost's redundant snapshot-based undo (FlowHistory{past,future,pending}: Vec<FlowFixture> stack) and rebuilt begin_change/begin_gesture/commit_gesture_history/undo/redo/can_undo/can_redo on top of the standard vcs::DocumentVcsStore<FlowFixture,FlowOperation> + FlowOperation::SetFixture (the already-existing invertible Operation/OperationDiff impl), via a lazily-flushed `history_store: FlowStore` + `pending_change: bool` field pair (public undo()/redo()/can_undo()/can_redo() signatures unchanged, so FlowSession (wasm) and flow/plugin needed zero call-site changes). Rewrote `undo_redo_add_widget` to exercise FlowStore/DocumentVcsCommand::Apply/Undo/Redo directly.

Step 2: Added dsl::DslDocument on FlowFixture (via a FlowFixtureDsl local twin — Widget's Vec<Widget> embeds foreign neural_engine Dictionary/Tree, so it can't derive directly) and dsl::DslOps on FlowOperation (via a FlowOperationDsl twin flattening vcs::CollectionOperation, mirroring imperative_core/process_3d precedent exactly). Local twins built: ValueDsl (Dictionary/Value/Atom, copied from imperative_core's identical fix), TreeDsl+NeuronNodeDsl (neural::Tree/Neuron, mutually recursive via NeuronNodeDsl's DslVariants lazy fn-pointer, same shape as imperative's PathDsl/StepNodeDsl), WidgetDsl (all 9 Widget variants, plus a hand dsl::DslField impl mirroring process_3d::SolidSpec's "exactly one tagged statement" idiom so it can sit as a bare block field in FlowOperationDsl's Add/Patch variants). Added #[derive(dsl::DslRecord)] directly to local plain-field types (WidgetLayout, CameraJson, SynapseSpec, FlowLayoutEntry) — no twin needed, no orphan issue. Widget::Cluster's `flow: FlowGui` field is deliberately kept as serde_json::Value passthrough (byte-for-byte round-tripping, untyped) rather than building a full nested FlowUi/FlowNodeGui/NodeChrome/FlowPreviewGui DSL grammar — it's GUI-only view state that never feeds neural evaluation (tree_from_fixture's Cluster handling reads only `tree`), the same "derived view, not DSL-typed" reasoning the task itself applies to FlowDocument vs FlowFixture, one level deeper. Converted flow/example/default.flow.json to flow/example/default.flow (real .flow DSL text) via the migration-test procedure (parse old JSON, print_dsl, reparse, assert equality, then delete the JSON); dag.manifest.json left untouched (confirmed unreferenced by any include_str!/Rust load site — a separate build artifact, not part of the FlowFixture/FlowDocument DSL round trip).

Verification (CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/claude-flow-dslgreen-target): cargo test -p flow_core → 90 passed, 1 failed (tests::neural_cache_persists_across_evaluations — confirmed PRE-EXISTING and unrelated: reproduced identically by reverting flow/core/rs/lib.rs to HEAD and rerunning in isolation, same failure at the same first assertion). cargo test -p flow-plugin → 24 passed, 0 failed, zero source changes needed (flow/plugin never called FlowHost's own undo/redo; its real undo/redo already flows through FlowOperation diffing + an external DocumentVcsStore).
